PWD.description: Optional project or workspace root used by the PWD convention. Accepts absolute POSIX, drive-letter, UNC, and translated Windows device paths such as /repo, D:\work, D:/work, or //?/D:/work. Empty or non-directory values are treated as absent; when absent, path must already be absolute.

path.description: Use the narrowest directory that may contain the target files. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. When PWD resolves to an existing directory, relative path values are resolved from that root and omitting path scans from PWD; otherwise path must already be absolute.

pattern.description: Use a basename-only file-name glob when the extension or file name shape is known, such as *.rs, *.lua, or Cargo.*. Do not include path separators such as src/*.lua or **/*.md; narrow directories with path instead. Defaults to all file names.

recursive.description: Keep true when searching a project tree. Set false only when the target must be a direct child of path.

noignore.description: Use only when ignored/generated directories are intentionally needed. Defaults to a common .gitignore/.ignore subset plus high-noise built-ins; true disables both file-based and built-in ignores.

limit.description: Use to cap broad scans. Defaults to 1000 and must be a positive integer up to 100000. Raise it only when the result is truncated and more candidate file names are still needed.
